fields.v: Metrics: ISR / CSR (avg of 3 judges); 3 runs per instance per model. Per scaffold (Table 3), ISR / CSR: Claude Code 2.0.69 + Claude Opus 4.5: 28.39 / 84.39; + MiniMax-M2.1: 18.60 / 82.75; + Gemini 3 Pro: 14.82 / 80.88; + Claude Sonnet 4.5: 16.71 / 80.85; + ChatGLM-4.6: 13.89 / 80.07; + Kimi-K2-Thinking: 14.42 / 79.61; + Doubao-Seed-1.8: 10.83 / 79.19; + MiniMax-M2: 11.04 / 79.88. Kilo 0.10.2 + Opus 4.5: 20.00 / 89.26; MiniMax-M2.1: 16.45 / 87.03; Gemini 3 Pro: 15.16 / 84.56; Sonnet 4.5: 4.44 / 80.91; GLM-4.6: 7.01 / 80.23; Kimi: 5.02 / 79.93; Doubao: 3.70 / 80.83; MiniMax-M2: 4.52 / 81.45. Droid 0.42.2 + Opus 4.5: 40.17 / 94.60; MiniMax-M2.1: 15.38 / 92.42; Gemini 3 Pro: 11.97 / 89.70; Sonnet 4.5: 7.78 / 84.74; GLM-4.6: 7.69 / 84.71; Kimi: 8.68 / 86.96; Doubao: 5.24 / 85.39; MiniMax-M2: 3.42 / 84.22. Overall avg ISR / CSR: Opus 4.5 28.11 / 85.64; MiniMax-M2.1 18.15 / 83.86; Gemini 3 Pro 14.68 / 80.94; Sonnet 4.5 14.65 / 81.10; GLM-4.6 12.73 / 80.38; Kimi 12.95 / 80.10; Doubao 9.66 / 79.75; MiniMax-M2 9.81 / 80.34. Verdicts: quality: no criterion stated by the authors (no ISR/CSR level is set as success for a configuration); cost: N/A (not measured)

fields.v: 217 instances under 3 scaffolds; 8 models; no baseline (benchmark comparison). Held constant: instance environment, checklist, scaffold defaults, temperature 1.0, Docker with network, timeout ~30 min. Acceptance criterion: binary checklist items judged by LLM panel. Repetitions: 3 runs per instance per model. Extra experiments: conflict set (32 instances), feedback-correction on Claude Code partial failures, ISR by turns, judge consistency. Human intervention: none during runs

fields.v: Large ISR-CSR gap (CSR 79.75-85.64% vs ISR 9.66-28.11%); Claude Opus 4.5 best overall and most robust across scaffolds and turns; Skill.md constraints weakest category, Memory strongest (e.g. Skill ISR Opus 58.45% vs MiniMax-M2.1 12.33% on Claude Code); system prompt beats project docs and user query beats project docs in conflicts, user vs system varies by model; feedback raises ISR by +7.2 to +16.8 points. No significance tests
